description: Figure 2, titled "Layer grouping patterns," is a bar chart that visually represents five different ways of distributing layers among four groups (G₁, G₂, G₃, G₄) in a neural network. The horizontal axis represents the group index, ranging from G₁ on the left to G₄ on the right. The vertical axis represents the number of layers within each group. The chart displays five distinct patterns: "Increasing," where the number of layers increases from G₁ to G₄; "Uniform," where the number of layers is the same across all four groups; "Decreasing," where the number of layers decreases from G₁ to G₄; "Spindle," where the number of layers is high in the middle groups (G₂ and G₃) and low at the ends (G₁ and G₄); and "Bottleneck," where the number of layers is high at the ends (G₁ and G₄) and low in the middle (G₂ and G₃).
